retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, blue-toned portrait framed by a window or doorway with a distinct three-tier typographic hierarchy in the upper right quadrant.
triggerTerms: blue duotone portrait with bold red text

recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, blue-tinted candid portrait of a man in glasses and a cap, viewed through a vertical frame, featuring a top-aligned typographic block with contrasting weights and colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by vertical architectural elements
Typographic block anchored to the top-right corner
High contrast between red text and blue-toned background
Text hierarchy moving from bold to outlined to italicized
coreInvariants: Vertical framing device on left and right edges
Three-part typographic stack in the upper third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait centered horizontally, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark-rimmed glasses and the bold red text in the top left of the text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red text, moves right to the outlined numbers, down to the italicized subtitle, then settles on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is relatively clear of detail to allow for legible text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and slate blue (photographic midtones and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the typography.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the primary title
Thin, consistent outline for the numeric element
Slanted, condensed forms for the subtitle
characterSpecificRedesigns: Open-counter '2' and '0' in the outlined section
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast through weight and style (bold solid vs. thin outline vs. light italic).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, bold sans-serif look of the primary title.
Provides the necessary weight and slant for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a blue-toned, grainy, candid portrait of a man with glasses and a cap, framed by vertical window edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text in the top right: a bold red lowercase title, a large black-outlined number to its right, and a smaller black italicized subtitle below.

verificationChecks: Is the main title lowercase and red?
Are the numbers outlined and larger than the text?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific band name or album title
Do not replicate the exact face of the individual in the photo
postGenerationChecks: Verify text is top-aligned and right-justified as a block
Ensure the framing elements are visible on the sides
Confirm the red text provides a strong focal point
recipe.reuseFormula: Blue-toned framed portrait + bold red lowercase sans + outlined numeric + italicized subtitle.
